name: JW Marriott Savannah Plant Riverside District
positioning: JW Marriott hotel in a former power plant on the Savannah riverfront, spread across three themed buildings
best_for: Travelers who want a lively riverfront base with live music and rooftop bars
Design lovers drawn to a repurposed power plant with playful decor

facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of historic Savannah on the riverfront.
Plant Riverside District was once a power plant.
The hotel spans three themed buildings: the Power Plant, the Three Muses and the Atlantic.
The hotel is owned by the Kessler Collection.
The Power Plant's rooms retain historic architectural details paired with modern-industrial styling.
The Atlantic building is inspired by a bespoke journey aboard a luxury yacht.
Poseidon Spa offers massages, HydraFacials and Wellness Rituals.
There are 24/7 fitness centers in each of the Power Plant, Three Muses and Atlantic buildings.
District Live, powered by Live Nation, is the onsite music venue bringing concerts to the riverfront.
Myrtle & Rose Rooftop Bar has views of both the river and the historic district.
Private dining is offered inside the hotel's 100-plus-year-old smokestack.
The riverwalk outside has high-end shops and galleries.

highlights.text: The Power Plant lobby features a life-size, chrome-dipped dinosaur.
The rooftop Compass Pool Lounge is available exclusively to hotel guests.
The Executive Studio suite has a living area with sofa bed, a marble walk-in bathtub and floor-to-ceiling views of the Savannah Riverfront.
Three Muses guestrooms have soft, sophisticated colors and are adorned with magical realist art.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Conde Nast Traveler found the spa and gym on the smaller side.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the riverfront area as a little touristy.
